title: Longest Substring Without Repeating
description: Given a string, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

refranceSolution.completeCode: process.stdin.resume(); process.stdin.setEncoding('utf-8'); let input=''; process.stdin.on('data', chunk=>input+=chunk); process.stdin.on('end', ()=>{ const s=input.trim(); const set=new Set(); let left=0,res=0; for(let right=0;right<s.length;right++){ while(set.has(s[right])){ set.delete(s[left]); left++; } set.add(s[right]); res=Math.max(res,right-left+1); } console.log(res); });

import java.util.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); String s=sc.next(); Set<Character> set=new HashSet<>(); int left=0,res=0; for(int right=0; right<s.length(); right++){ while(set.contains(s.charAt(right))){ set.remove(s.charAt(left)); left++; } set.add(s.charAt(right)); res=Math.max(res,right-left+1); } System.out.println(res); } }
